```yaml
name: CLI Publish and Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'cli/**'
      - '.github/workflows/cli-publish.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        node-version: [18]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm test

      - name: Run Doctor diagnostics
        run: |
          pnpm cli doctor
          echo "Doctor diagnostics completed successfully"

  publish-npm:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Build CLI
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Publish to npm
        run: pnpm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

  release-github:
    needs: publish-npm
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Create Release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ github.sha }}
          release_name: CLI Release ${{ github.sha }}
          body: |
            ## CLI Distribution Release
            
            This release includes:
            - Production-ready CLI tooling
            - Doctor diagnostics command
            - Fuzzy search enhancement
            - Cross-platform support
            
            See commit history for detailed changes.
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

  validate-metadata:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Validate plugin metadata
        run: |
          pnpm cli list --json | jq '.plugins | length' | grep -q "259" && echo "✅ All 259 plugins validated" || echo "❌ Plugin count mismatch"
          
      - name: Run fuzzy search test
        run: |
          pnpm cli search python-pro --json | grep -q "python-pro" && echo "✅ Fuzzy search working" || echo "❌ Fuzzy search failed"

  cross-platform-validation:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 18
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Test CLI commands
        run: |
          pnpm cli --help
          pnpm cli list --json | head -n 5
          pnpm cli doctor --json | grep -q "checks.*passed" && echo "✅ Doctor command works" || echo "❌ Doctor command failed"
```
